shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a purple shirt sits in the patio-side window seat and asks about preferred tea preparation, a man in a red shirt sits in the sideboard-side window seat, and a woman in a green shirt sits in the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: The man in a red shirt leaves his seat and exits the venue, while the man in a purple shirt questions the tea instructions.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a purple shirt explains the tea recipe.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the patio-side window seat.

shots.content: The man in a purple shirt summarizes the tea serving plan.
